thread:
anya: Quick check export & retention proposal: keep full privileged auth logs 30d, metadata-only 1y, archive minimal 7y. SIEM streams default to metadata. Full-event exports only via ticket + approver.

meera: Agree on tiers. Suggest human-admin 30d, user 14d, service-account 7d for full detail.

derek: Implementation: export-proxy writes filtered objects encrypted with ephemeral data key; data key wrapped by CMK and bound to ticket id + TTL. Unwrap token is single-use and expires.

olivia: Policy: require a second approver for export TTL >24h and require justification string + example queries.

sec-bot: Reminder: any export must include JIRA id and runbook link.

meera: Incident response: allow emergency bypass (1h TTL) but log to tamper-evident audit and notify legal/CISO automatically.

derek: Add redaction_profile to config so PCI/PII pipelines apply automatically unless explicit forensics flag.

anya: I'll draft RFC with retention matrix, connector types (metadata vs full), export-proxy flow, RBAC template, and emergency playbook. Comments by EOD Fri? :thumbsup:
